name: Composition Test Line v2 — Full Arrangement

sections.label: Intro
sections.text:
夜明け前
A quiet light

sections.label: Verse (Aメロ)
sections.text:
歩き出すこの道
I keep moving on

sections.label: Pre-Chorus (Bメロ)
sections.text:
胸の奥で
A spark is growing

sections.label: Chorus (サビ)
sections.text:
明日を照らして
We can reach the sky

sections.label: Final
sections.text:
光の向こうへ
Carry this light
